module.name: BigSpill
module.author: Patrick H.
module.description: A 97‑function Excel LAMBDA library for 2D array shaping, grid algebra, combinatorics, text processing, and analytics.

functions.name: DGridλ
functions.description: Direction grid (0°-360°) using centered Cartesian axes

functions.name: CGridλ
functions.description: Cartesian grid (row or column coordinates, centered)

functions.name: MGridλ
functions.description: Mesh grid (1‑based row or column indices)

functions.name: TGridλ
functions.description: Thresholded mesh grid (indices wrap after a limit)

functions.name: PolarGridλ
functions.description: Polar coordinates: radial distance and angle (ATAN2)

functions.name: Circleλ
functions.description: Circular region by target or {row, col} center

functions.name: Diamondλ
functions.description: Manhattan‑radius diamond

functions.name: Plusλ
functions.description: Cross‑shaped region (von Neumann neighborhood)

functions.name: Pyramidλ
functions.description: Directional half‑diamond (four pieces)

functions.name: Ringλ
functions.description: Layer‑based perimeter extraction

functions.name: Squareλ
functions.description: Chebyshev‑radius square

functions.name: Triangleλ
functions.description: Directional triangular region (above or below)

functions.name: ReShape2Dλ
functions.description: Reshapes a 2D array into a new column width using row‑major order

functions.name: Scan2Dλ
functions.description: Traversal‑aware 2D scanning operator extending Excel’s native SCAN

functions.name: Traverseλ
functions.description: Remaps a 2D array into a new traversal order using diagonal directions

functions.name: Resizeλ
functions.description: Repeats a 2D array vertically and/or horizontally by integer repeat counts

functions.name: TakeBlockλ
functions.description: Extracts a rectangular block using start_at and optional stop_when

functions.name: DStackλ
functions.description: Stacks multiple 2D arrays along a depth dimension

functions.name: WrapRows2Dλ
functions.description: Wraps into row blocks of specified height

functions.name: WrapCols2Dλ
functions.description: Wraps into column blocks of specified width

functions.name: Staircaseλ
functions.description: Constructs diagonal staircase patterns

functions.name: ValidateStaircaseλ
functions.description: Validates Staircaseλ

functions.name: UnPivotλ
functions.description: Converts a matrix into a flattened row‑wise table

functions.name: Zipλ
functions.description: Zips 1-4 arrays by flattening and aligning by length

functions.name: SliceByDegλ
functions.description: Extracts angular slices using degree bounds (0°-360°)

functions.name: Padλ
functions.description: Applies row and/or column padding to any array

functions.name: InsulateRowsλ
functions.description: Adds rows of padding before and/or after an input array

functions.name: InsulateColsλ
functions.description: Adds columns of padding before and/or after an input array

functions.name: Magnifyλ
functions.description: Expands each element into a block of specified height × width using nearest‑neighbor interpolation

functions.name: Zoomλ
functions.description: Expands each element into a block whose size matches the height × width of zoom_kernel

functions.name: DeleteRowsλ
functions.description: Deletes rows from a 2D array based on contiguous subgroup runs

functions.name: DeleteColsλ
functions.description: Deletes columns from a 2D array based on contiguous subgroup runs

functions.name: DeleteWhereλ
functions.description: Removes vertical and horizontal vectors based on a predicate LAMBDA

functions.name: Pinchλ
functions.description: Removes rows/columns whose cells all have LEN(cell) = 0

functions.name: Removeλ
functions.description: Removes specific rows and/or columns

functions.name: Squeezeλ
functions.description: Removes null and straight‑zero vectors with optional custom_criteria

functions.name: KroneckerProdλ
functions.description: Computes the Kronecker product of two arrays

functions.name: Excludeλ
functions.description: Filters an array by excluding any row containing a specified criterion

functions.name: Snapλ
functions.description: Selects rows containing at least one value from the include‑criteria

functions.name: Shiftλ
functions.description: Circular shift on scalar, 1D, or 2D arrays

functions.name: ShiftRowsλ
functions.description: Circular horizontal shift per row

functions.name: ShiftColsλ
functions.description: Circular vertical shift per column

functions.name: Embedλ
functions.description: Embeds an array into a 2D host at a specified row or column index

functions.name: KeepRowsλ
functions.description: Retains rows based on contiguous subgroup runs

functions.name: KeepColsλ
functions.description: Retains columns based on contiguous subgroup runs

functions.name: BlockMapλ
functions.description: Reshapes a matrix row‑wise or column‑wise into blocks of size depth × width

functions.name: ValidateBlockMapλ
functions.description: Validates BlockMapλ

functions.name: Convolveλ
functions.description: Performs sliding‑window convolution using a 2D kernel

functions.name: Foldλ
functions.description: Groups identical rows and aggregates values from values_array

functions.name: Join2Dλ
functions.description: Joins non‑empty values across 2-4 identically‑shaped arrays using a delimiter

functions.name: Echoλ
functions.description: Repeats each element in a 1D array according to repeat counts

functions.name: RepeatRowsλ
functions.description: Repeats each row according to repeat counts

functions.name: RepeatColsλ
functions.description: Repeats each column according to repeat counts

functions.name: Tessellateλ
functions.description: Generates a modular tessellation of a 2D pattern defined by new_height × new_width

functions.name: Streakλ
functions.description: Computes streak counts of consecutive identical values

functions.name: Countdownλ
functions.description: Generates countdown indices for contiguous runs

functions.name: Instanceλ
functions.description: Obtain the instance numbers for unsorted values in a 1D array

functions.name: Waveλ
functions.description: Returns a vertical 1D wave array by supplying a crest and optional rep_count

functions.name: ByDiagλ
functions.description: Applies an ETA function or LAMBDA to each diagonal

functions.name: DiagMapλ
functions.description: Extracts all diagonals and returns them as a 2D matrix

functions.name: DiagIndexλ
functions.description: Extracts a single diagonal or anti‑diagonal vector

functions.name: ValidateDiagλ
functions.description: Validates ByDiagλ

functions.name: Pairwiseλ
functions.description: Creates vertical pairs from 1D and scalar inputs

functions.name: Triplewiseλ
functions.description: Generates a Cartesian product from 3 sets

functions.name: Quadwiseλ
functions.description: Generates a Cartesian product from 4 sets

functions.name: GroupbyBinλ
functions.description: Aggregates values into fixed‑width numeric bins

functions.name: GroupbyDateλ
functions.description: Aggregates values by date/time interval (minute → year)

functions.name: ValidateGDλ
functions.description: Validates GroupbyDateλ

functions.name: PivotbyCatλ
functions.description: Pivots data by categories and values

functions.name: GroupIndexλ
functions.description: Assign numerical group indices to a 1D array

functions.name: Occurrenceλ
functions.description: Selects the Nth occurrences of rows from a specified 2D array

functions.name: OccurrenceRangeλ
functions.description: Selects a range of occurrences of rows from a specified 2D array

functions.name: Grainλ
functions.description: Downsamples a matrix by aggregating non‑overlapping spatial blocks

functions.name: MooreAggλ
functions.description: Aggregates over Moore or von Neumann neighborhoods using ETA functions

functions.name: MooreSelectλ
functions.description: Selects a specific neighbor (1-9) from the Moore neighborhood

functions.name: Histogramλ
functions.description: Generates a histogram using automatic binning rules

functions.name: Modeλ
functions.description: Returns the most frequently occurring values or text entries

functions.name: ZoneStatλ
functions.description: Aggregates values by zones determined by Histogramλ

functions.name: Alignλ
functions.description: Sorts each row or column alphabetically

functions.name: AlignDistinctλ
functions.description: Sorted distinct values

functions.name: AlignUniqueλ
functions.description: Sorted unique values

functions.name: Coalesceλ
functions.description: Returns the first non‑empty value across 2–4 arrays

functions.name: Explodeλ
functions.description: Converts scalar, 1D, or 2D input into exploded character array

functions.name: NumbersOnlyλ
functions.description: Extracts numeric characters (0–9)

functions.name: TextOnlyλ
functions.description: Extracts non‑numeric characters

functions.name: Splitλ
functions.description: Splits text arrays into tokens and can return a 2D spill

functions.name: RegexSafeλ
functions.description: Validates Splitλ

functions.name: Bin2Decλ
functions.description: Converts concise binary → decimal

functions.name: Bin2Grayλ
functions.description: Converts binary → Gray code

functions.name: BitCountλ
functions.description: Counts number of 1‑bits

functions.name: Dec2Binλ
functions.description: Converts non‑negative integers → binary

functions.name: Dec2Grayλ
functions.description: Converts non‑negative integers → Gray code

functions.name: Enumerateλ
functions.description: Generating function for PermRλ, Permλ, Combinationsλ, and Derangementsλ

functions.name: PermRλ
functions.description: Permutations with replacement

functions.name: Permλ
functions.description: Permutations without replacement

functions.name: CombinationsRλ
functions.description: Combinations with replacement

functions.name: Combinationsλ
functions.description: Combinations without replacement

functions.name: Derangementsλ
functions.description: Permutations where no element remains in its original position

functions.name: KnapSackλ
functions.description: Solves the 0–1 Knapsack problem

functions.name: SubsetGenλ
functions.description: Generates all subsets (power set) in binary‑mask order

functions.name: SubsetSumλ
functions.description: Returns all subsets whose elements sum to a target

functions.name: Revealλ
functions.description: Returns either a semantic summary (Numbers, Texts, Errors, etc.) or a verbose cell‑by‑cell narration
